note: Local review accounts for the development stack only. backend/e2e/stack review-accounts creates or updates them on a localhost stack. All accounts share one password. The password is never stored in this public file: the command reads it from E2E_REVIEW_PASSWORD in the Git-ignored backend/e2e/.env file.

accounts.purpose: Headless panel review at http://localhost:5180 as a tenant employee with HR roles.
Tenant administrator review. G-53 keeps System Manager for the platform operator only, so this account is a Website User whose only role is Tenant Admin, given by the Tenant Admin role profile.
Tenant administrator assistant review (G-168). A Website User whose only role comes from its role profile; no System Manager.
Reseller administrator review (G-169). The stack's tenant site is the reseller tenant. A Website User whose only role comes from its role profile; no System Manager.
Reseller assistant review (G-170). The stack's tenant site is the reseller tenant. A Website User whose only role comes from its role profile; no System Manager.
Keycloak administration console of the local stack.

reseller_links_note: Two sample resellers with one sample customer each, kept as Reseller Customer Link rows on the stack's tenant site. tenant1.localhost is the reseller the reseller review accounts sign in to. bayi-iki.example.test is a second reseller recorded only as link data, so the review can see that one reseller never lists the customer of another.
